collection("community.family_groups", "family_group", "community", source("15 families own 2 dogs, 20 families own 1 dog, while the remaining families own 2 cats each"))
member("community.family_groups", "community.family_groups.remaining_two_cat_owners", source("the remaining families own 2 cats each"))

member("community.dogs_and_cats", "community.dogs_and_cats.from_remaining_two_cat_owners", source("the remaining families own 2 cats each"))
